# Agustin Diaz-Cano - Software Engineer

## AI Agent Usage (Last 30 Days)
- **Combined Total**: ~9.85 Billion tokens across 262 sessions (2026-10-06 to 2026-11-04).
- **Per-Agent Breakdown**: Claude Code (~8.18B tokens, 140 sessions) | Antigravity (~949.1M tokens, 63 sessions) | Codex (~615.7M tokens, 48 sessions) | Meta Muse (~95.1M tokens, 9 sessions) | Grok (~5.4M tokens, 2 sessions) | Cursor (server-side only, 0 local transcript sessions, no local token counters).
- **Reference Comparisons**: The combined count is approximately 193 months (~16.1 years) at 51M tokens/month, or 26 months (~2.2 years) at 380M tokens/month. It is numerically comparable to one month at the median rate for ~193 developers.
- **Benchmark Source**: [Jellyfish Q1 2026 study](https://jellyfish.co/blog/is-tokenmaxxing-cost-effective-new-data-from-jellyfish-explains/) reported 51M tokens/month at the median and 380M at the 90th percentile among 12,000 developers at 200 companies. These are reference rates, not a global ranking; accounting methods and coverage may differ.

## About

Software Engineer | Python Developer with 4+ years of experience in software development, specializing in AI/ML and Backend Development (Python).

I'm currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Systems Engineering at UTN, focused on Artificial Intelligence and Data Analysis. My technical focus is building backend architectures that integrate GenAI in production-realistic conditions, not just prototypes. I'm developing projects with Python, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to explore LLM orchestration and AI agent design.

Previously, Sole QA Owner and quality authority for Grupo GDU's e-commerce platforms. Responsible for the entire quality strategy of web and mobile across multiple high-traffic sites, covering a multi-million dollar online channel with hundreds of thousands of users. Held full Go/No-Go authority on production releases with no dedicated QA team. During my tenure, the platforms—previously unranked—achieved nominations for the eCommerce Awards Uruguay in 2024 and 2025.

Transitioned from zero coding background in the pre-AI era. Wrote my first line of code in November 2020, received a job offer on May 14, 2021, and shipped my first production PR in June 2021 at an international fintech. Participated in more than 10 projects that reached production.

In game development, I created full modifications for the Men of War series as a solo developer, reaching over 200,000 downloads. Only a small percentage of Steam games, mods, and mobile apps (typically under 2-5%, and often closer to 1% for the 100k threshold) ever reach that level of adoption.
